chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: Water's Edge into Leaf Slime (M) for exactly 6, killing it, then All Streams Flow to the Sea into Leaf Slime (S) for 9, killing it. Two cards, two energy, two corpses. Both Leaf Slimes sit at 6 HP with no Block, so each of my single-target attacks is exactly enough or more; the Twig Slime's 8 Block makes it the wrong place to spend anything, since All Streams would push only 1 damage through it. Killing the Medium Leaf cancels the 2 Status cards it was about to hand me, and killing the Small Leaf cancels 3 of the 7 incoming damage. I eat the Twig's 4 and end at 12 HP with the board down to one blocked-up 9 HP enemy. The third energy goes unspent because nothing in hand costs 1 anymore and Sanctifying Circle costs 3.
q2_other_line_considered: Shinobu - Sanctifying Circle alone, for the 4 Block and the 3-to-all. I checked it and dropped it fast: 3 damage to all kills nothing, it is fully absorbed by the Twig's 8 Block, and it leaves both Leaf Slimes alive to hand me 2 Status cards and hit me for 3. Trading 4 Block against 3 damage prevented plus two Status cards denied plus two enemies removed from the fight is not close. I also looked at pointing All Streams at the Twig Slime to start chewing its Block, and rejected it — 9 into 8 Block is 1 damage and lets both Leaf Slimes live.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The 4 Block, so I take the Twig's full 4 and drop to 12 of 70, which is thin. It also gives up all progress against the Twig Slime: its 8 Block is untouched, it is still at 9 HP, and I spent nothing softening it, so next turn starts with that Block possibly refreshed. And it wastes 3 damage of overkill on the Small Leaf plus one unspent energy, since Sanctifying Circle could not be afforded alongside anything.
q4_different_intent: Yes, though it would take a lot. With the telegraph as printed, total incoming is 7 and killing two enemies beats blocking 4. If the Twig Slime had telegraphed a genuinely dangerous hit — something in the low teens against my 16 HP — and the Leaf Slimes were doing nothing threatening, Sanctifying Circle becomes the play purely for the Block and the chip damage, accepting the Status cards. Short of that, no intent on the two 6 HP slimes changes anything: they die either way, and removing them is worth more than 4 Block.
